_about: Legacy /pos → React /pos-v2 parity map. Keyed by slug so parallel closure streams can append entries without stomping each other. status: done | partial | deferred.

pwa-manifest.notes: «كاشير المذاق», rtl/ar, standalone, start_url+scope './' (base-relative: identical file serves /pos-v2/ now and /pos/ after cutover), theme #0e1726 / background #f2f5f9, 192+512 maskable PNG icons (programmatically generated).

pwa-service-worker.v2: frontend/pos/public/sw.js (CACHE_NAME mt-posv2-<version> — cannot collide with legacy)
pwa-service-worker.notes: Hand-rolled, same battle-tested strategy: HTML/JS network-first with cache fallback, static stale-while-revalidate, /api/* NEVER cached, skipWaiting + clients.claim, old mt-posv2-* caches deleted on activate. Precache list comes from Vite's build manifest (asset-manifest.json at dist root — build.manifest in frontend/pos/vite.config.ts) fetched at SW install time.
pwa-service-worker.verify: node --check + e2e/pos/offline.spec.ts (shell served offline, controller on 2nd load)

pwa-install-prompt.legacy: browser default (legacy relied on Chrome's own install UI)
pwa-install-prompt.v2: frontend/pos/src/lib/pwa.ts + Header PwaControls («تثبيت التطبيق» button when beforeinstallprompt is captured)
pwa-install-prompt.notes: Deferred-prompt capture + promptInstall(); appinstalled clears the button.
pwa-install-prompt.verify: manual — Chromium shows the button once installability criteria pass

pwa-update-signal.legacy: silent skipWaiting (legacy users picked up new code on next reload without notice)
pwa-update-signal.v2: sw.js POSV2_SW_UPDATED postMessage → Header «نسخة جديدة — تحديث» action (reload)
pwa-update-signal.notes: Only fires on a real update (old mt-posv2-* cache existed), never on first install.
pwa-update-signal.verify: bump SW_VERSION, redeploy, open a controlled page → button appears

offline-shell-cache.v2: frontend/pos/public/sw.js precache from asset-manifest.json (hashed bundle) + './' + manifest + icons
offline-shell-cache.notes: Offline navigation falls back to the cached shell ('./') for ANY in-scope URL (SPA fallback).
offline-shell-cache.verify: e2e/pos/offline.spec.ts steps 4–6 (close, reopen offline, shell renders)

offline-sale-queue.v2: frontend/pos/src/lib/offline.ts — IndexedDB FIFO op queue, submit→/api/sales→complete with clientOrderId dedupe (pre-existing)
offline-sale-queue.notes: This stream added the E2E proof: offline cash checkout queues, survives restart, replays to exactly ONE sales row.
offline-sale-queue.verify: e2e/pos/offline.spec.ts — 'eight-step offline sale lifecycle' (asserts the MySQL row count by client_order_id)

offline-legacy-queue-drain.legacy: pos_offline_queue entries could strand if the terminal moved to /pos-v2 before syncing
offline-legacy-queue-drain.v2: frontend/pos/src/lib/legacyDrain.ts (boot-once, online-only) + App report dialog + Header chip
offline-legacy-queue-drain.notes: Replays each entry through POST /api/sales exactly as legacy would ({...order, username, shiftId}); clientOrderId dedupe makes replay safe. ONLY successes are cleared — rejections/transport failures/malformed records are retained verbatim and surfaced («تمت مزامنة X عملية من النسخة القديمة» + report dialog). Stricter than legacy, which dropped server-rejected entries.
offline-legacy-queue-drain.verify: frontend/pos/src/lib/__tests__/legacyDrain.test.ts (11 tests: parsing, exact replay body, idempotent replay, partial-failure retention, transport stop, offline no-op)
